messages:
Maya (seceng): Auditor just asked for a single-package deliverable for SOC2 evidence covering RBAC changes + KMS integration. Can we assemble a minimal packet?
Kevin (platform): I can pull RBAC change PRs and link to deploy logs. Which date range do they want?
Auditor (third-party): Hi team — thanks. We need change history for the last 12 months, a mapping of controls to artifacts, and the KMS key rotation proof. Preferable format: single tarball with a manifest.
Sophie (GRC): 12 months works. We should include control mapping doc (CC: CC6, CC7), the PR ids, issue tracker links, and the incident timeline for any RBAC regressions. I'll draft the mapping.
Alex (infra): For KMS, we can export rotation logs from CloudKMS and add the KMS key metadata. I'll include key IDs and rotation timestamps. Anyone want the exact command I used?
Kevin (platform): Yes please — include exact `gcloud`/`aws` commands plus a redacted log example. e.g., `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --location global`.
Maya (seceng): Also include audit logging config: where the logs live (s3://redwood-logs/security/...), retention policy (730 days), and the log ingestion pipeline snapshot. Add samples of logged events showing RBAC grant and revoke.
AuditBot: Evidence upload: compliance-bundle-1802345678.tar.gz uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2026/03/ and checksum sha256: 3b7a...fa2d.
Auditor (third-party): Thanks. A couple follow-ups: 1) How do you ensure least privilege for service accounts created during that period? 2) Do you have proof of key rotation automation?
Sophie (GRC): For least privilege we have PR templates that require `risk_review` and `scopes` fields and automated checks in CI that fail if a role is broadly-scoped. I'll attach the PR template and CI job logs.
Alex (infra): Key rotation is automated via a nightly job: `infra/scripts/kms_rotate.sh` which calls the cloud provider API and updates secrets manager. I'll include the cronjob YAML and a run log snippet: `2026-02-11T03:00Z - rotated key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/service-key`.
Maya (seceng): On vuln triage, include the triage notes for CVE-2025-xxxx — the playbook used, timelines, and the verification checklist we executed before closing.
Kevin (platform): I uploaded the RBAC change list CSV: `rbac_changes_2025_03.csv` with columns (ts, author, PR, target, change_type). Also added the deployment trace IDs for rollout.
Sophie (GRC): I'll produce the control mapping doc `SOC2_control_map_2026-03.md` linking each artifact to the control statement. Will also note any compensating controls for gaps.
Auditor (third-party): One more: can you provide evidence that audit logs are immutable/append-only and retention enforced? An export or snapshot showing the log ingestion pipeline + S3 Object Lock settings would be ideal.
Alex (infra): Added S3 bucket policy and Object Lock config snippet in the bundle. Also included CloudTrail/Stackdriver export config and a sample WORM-enabled object metadata.
Maya (seceng): Good. Final checklist before we hand off: manifest, PRs, CI logs, KMS rotation logs, RBAC CSV, incident timelines, triage notes, Object Lock evidence, and control map. Anything missing?
Kevin (platform): Add proofs of rollbacks/fallbacks for any canary that failed — deployment artifacts are in `deployments/2025/` in the bundle.
Sophie (GRC): I'll review tonight and send the final tarball link to the auditor. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Auditor (third-party): Received the bundle and the follow-ups are helpful. I'll review and open any clarifying questions in a new thread. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maya (seceng): Thanks — ping me if they ask for expanded logs or raw CloudKMS exports.
